tools.name: ping_host
tools.description: Check host reachability and open ports. Use when: 'is X up?', 'can we reach X?', 'ping X'. Requires: target (hostname or IP)

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: Scan for security vulnerabilities, CVEs, and missing patches. Use when: 'security scan X', 'vulnerabilities on X'. Requires: target (hostname or IP)

tools.name: get_host_info
tools.description: Get system info (OS, CPU, RAM, disk, uptime). Use when: 'system info for X', 'what's running on X'. Requires: target (hostname or IP)

tools.name: patch_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Apply security patches and verify system is clean. Use when: 'patch X', 'fix vulnerabilities on X', 'remediate X'. Requires: target (hostname or IP)
